In this video we cover:
Vedanta vs Viceroy: Serious Allegations Uncovered
Vedanta’s stock crashed 8% after US short seller Viceroy Research accused the company of running a "Ponzi-like scheme." The report alleges misuse of dividends, hidden debt, inflated assets, and shady capital flows to help its debt-heavy parent, Vedanta Resources. Vedanta has denied all claims, calling the report misleading and profit-driven. But rising debt and falling cash raise serious concerns.
